Clemson is 124th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 23:51, while Georgia Southern's 122nd-ranked average is 24:55. Moore, 31 yards on 4 catches, 0 TDs Georgia Southern Passing: Max Johnson, 281 yards, 1 TD, 0 INTs, 71.8 completion percentage Rushing: Jamarian Samuel, 46 yards on 4 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Ashton Hollins, 106 yards on 8 catches, 1 TD Last game Clemson fell to LSU 51-10 on Sept. 5.
